caption: The drawing depicts a square textile composed of numerous multicolored strips arranged in a geometric and symmetrical pattern. The textile is divided into four triangular sections by two diagonal bands that cross at the center, each band made up of alternating red, green, and black stripes. Within each triangular section, there are multiple parallel bands of fabric strips running diagonally, filled with a variety of patterns including stripes, checks, and solid colors. The colors used include red, green, blue, black, yellow, white, and brown, among others. The strips within each triangle are arranged to create a mirrored and repetitive effect, enhancing the overall symmetry of the composition. Each strip varies in width and design, some containing tiny geometric shapes or lines, with the arrangement collectively forming a vivid, highly-patterned quilt-like appearance. The textile is set against a plain, light background.
title: Bedspread
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
